raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44897. With `--ep-dispatch-algorithm fake`, `transform_select_experts_inputs` fills the router logits with noise and replaces the correction bias with zeros, so the simulated routing ignores the bias. On ROCm with aiter, `select_experts` then overwrites that zeroed bias with `topk_config.correction_bias_for_dtype(router_logits.dtype)`, a cached cast of the model's real bias. The aiter router picks experts from noise plus the real bias, so the "fake" expert distribution is skewed toward the experts the bias favours. On CUDA the zeroed bias is kept.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`: use the cached cast only while `correction_bias` is still `topk_config.correction_bias`. A bias that `transform_select_experts_inputs` replaced is passed through unchanged; the aiter branch of `biased_grouped_topk_gpu` already handles either dtype per call.
- `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_topk_correction_bias_cache.py`: a CPU regression test that runs `select_experts` with `_use_aiter` patched on and the aiter kernel mocked, and records the bias the router receives. With fake dispatch the bias must be all zeros (bf16 and fp32 bias); with no dispatch info and with `static` dispatch it must still be the config's bias, so normal serving is unchanged.

This is independent of #44797, which skips the cast for fp32 biases (#44794). That PR alone keeps the zeroed bias only when it is fp32; a bf16 bias, as DeepSeek checkpoints with fp8, compressed-tensors or quark quantization have on aiter, would still be replaced. Both PRs add a condition to the same `if`, so whichever merges second needs a one-line rebase that keeps both conditions.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: only `--ep-dispatch-algorithm fake` changes; normal routing is unchanged (covered by the test above).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: one identity comparison on the host per call.

## Validation

- `test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_topk_correction_bias_cache.py`: 5 passed. With the `topk.py` change reverted, both fake-dispatch subtests (bf16 and fp32 bias) fail and the normal-dispatch test still passes.
- The CPU reproduction from #44897 prints `True` for both dtypes (was `False`).
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes.

Like the reproduction in the issue, this patches `_use_aiter` and mocks the aiter kernel; I did not run it on an AMD GPU.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -2616,10 +2616,14 @@ def select_experts(
     # Only aiter_biased_grouped_topk wants the bias in the gating dtype. The JIT
     # router returns before it in biased_grouped_topk_gpu and upcasts the bias
     # in-register, so downcasting here would only buy it a per-call cast back.
+    # The cached copy is of topk_config.correction_bias, so only use it while
+    # correction_bias is still that tensor: the fake EP dispatch above replaces
+    # it with zeros, which must reach the router.
     if (
         _use_aiter
         and use_grouped_topk
         and correction_bias is not None
+        and correction_bias is topk_config.correction_bias
         and not envs.SGLANG_OPT_USE_JIT_KERNEL_GROUPED_TOPK.get()
         and dynamic_expert_bias is None
     ):

@@ -1,8 +1,11 @@
 import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import torch
 
-from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKConfig
+from sglang.srt.eplb.expert_location_dispatch import ExpertLocationDispatchInfo
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe import topk as topk_module
+from sglang.srt.layers.moe.topk import TopKConfig, select_experts
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
 
@@ -57,5 +60,75 @@ class TestCorrectionBiasCacheCPU(CorrectionBiasCacheTestMixin, CustomTestCase):
     device = "cpu"
 
 
+class TestAiterCorrectionBiasWithFakeDispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    """select_experts on the aiter path must not swap the bias that the fake EP
+    dispatch zeroed for the config's real bias (#44897)."""
+
+    num_experts = 16
+
+    def _bias_seen_by_aiter(self, bias_dtype, ep_dispatch_algorithm):
+        n = self.num_experts
+        seen = {}
+
+        def fake_aiter_biased_grouped_topk(gating_output, correction_bias, w, ids, *a):
+            seen["bias"] = correction_bias.clone()
+            w.zero_()
+            ids.zero_()
+
+        info = None
+        if ep_dispatch_algorithm is not None:
+            info = ExpertLocationDispatchInfo(
+                ep_dispatch_algorithm=ep_dispatch_algorithm,
+                partial_logical_to_rank_dispatch_physical_map=torch.arange(n),
+                partial_logical_to_all_physical_map=torch.arange(n).unsqueeze(1),
+                partial_logical_to_all_physical_map_num_valid=torch.ones(
+                    n, dtype=torch.int64
+                ),
+                num_physical_experts=n,
+                rank_invariant=True,
+            )
+        config = TopKConfig(
+            top_k=2,
+            use_grouped_topk=True,
+            topk_group=1,
+            num_expert_group=1,
+            correction_bias=torch.linspace(1, 2, n).to(bias_dtype),
+        )
+        with (
+            patch.object(topk_module, "_use_aiter", True),
+            patch.object(topk_module, "_is_cuda", False),
+            patch.object(
+                topk_module, "biased_grouped_topk", topk_module.biased_grouped_topk_gpu
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                topk_module,
+                "aiter_biased_grouped_topk",
+                fake_aiter_biased_grouped_topk,
+                create=True,
+            ),
+        ):
+            select_experts(
+                torch.randn(4, 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                torch.randn(4, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+                config,
+                expert_location_dispatch_info=info,
+            )
+        return seen["bias"], config.correction_bias
+
+    def test_fake_dispatch_bias_stays_zero(self):
+        for bias_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            with self.subTest(bias_dtype=bias_dtype):
+                seen, _ = self._bias_seen_by_aiter(bias_dtype, "fake")
+                self.assertTrue(bool((seen == 0).all()))
+
+    def test_real_dispatch_still_uses_config_bias(self):
+        for ep_dispatch_algorithm in (None, "static"):
+            with self.subTest(ep_dispatch_algorithm=ep_dispatch_algorithm):
+                seen, bias = self._bias_seen_by_aiter(
+                    torch.bfloat16, ep_dispatch_algorithm
+                )
+                torch.testing.assert_close(seen, bias)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
